knowledge.question_zh: 几点可以入住？几点要退房？
knowledge.answer_zh: 入住时间为入住当天15:00以后，退房时间为离店当天12:00以前。
knowledge.question_en: What are the check-in and check-out times?
knowledge.answer_en: Check-in is from 15:00 on your arrival day, and check-out is by 12:00 on your departure day.

knowledge.question_zh: 可以提前入住吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 可以申请提前入住：当天房间已打扫好的话，最早13:00可以入住，不加收费用；房间没准备好时不能提前，可以先免费寄存行李。请在入住前一天20:00前告诉管家预计到店时间，能否提前以入住当天的房间情况为准。
knowledge.question_en: Can I check in early?
knowledge.answer_en: You can request early check-in. If your room is already cleaned that day, you can check in from 13:00 at no extra cost; if it isn't ready, you can store your luggage for free. Please tell the host your arrival time by 20:00 the day before; whether early check-in works depends on the room on the day.

knowledge.question_zh: 可以延迟退房吗？怎么收费？
knowledge.answer_zh: 延迟退房需要提前申请：延到14:00退房加收50元；14:00至18:00之间退房加收半晚房费；18:00以后按一晚房费计算。法定节假日、节假日前一天和每周六不提供延迟退房。
knowledge.question_en: Can I check out late? How much is it?
knowledge.answer_en: Late check-out must be requested in advance: until 14:00 costs an extra 50 yuan; between 14:00 and 18:00 costs half a night's rate; after 18:00 a full night is charged. Late check-out is not available on public holidays, the day before a public holiday, or on Saturdays.

knowledge.question_zh: 房门密码怎么拿到？
knowledge.answer_zh: 入住当天14:00前，系统会通过企业微信把房门密码和入住指引单独发给订单联系人。聊天里不会提供或转发密码，也请不要把密码告诉非入住人员。到时间还没收到的话，请在企业微信里联系管家核对订单。
knowledge.question_en: How do I get the door code?
knowledge.answer_en: Before 14:00 on check-in day, the door code and check-in guide are sent separately to the booking contact via WeCom. Codes are never given out or forwarded in chat, and please don't share yours with anyone not staying with you. If it hasn't arrived by then, please message the host on WeCom to check your booking.

knowledge.question_zh: 民宿地址在哪里？怎么导航？
knowledge.answer_zh: 民宿地址是武汉市江汉区芸栖路16号芸栖小楼。导航请搜索“芸栖小楼”，入口是临街的黑色铁门，门牌上写着“芸栖小楼”。
knowledge.question_en: What's the address and how do I navigate there?
knowledge.answer_en: The address is Yunqi House (芸栖小楼), No. 16 Yunqi Road, Jianghan District, Wuhan. Search for “芸栖小楼” in your map app; the entrance is the black iron gate facing the street with the “芸栖小楼” sign.

knowledge.question_zh: 最近的地铁站在哪？离民宿多远？
knowledge.answer_zh: 离民宿最近的地铁站是6号线芸栖路站，距离约450米，从B口出站后步行约6分钟就到。
knowledge.question_en: Which metro station is closest, and how far is it?
knowledge.answer_en: The closest metro station is Yunqi Road Station on Line 6. From Exit B it's about a 6-minute walk, roughly 450 m.

knowledge.question_zh: 到江汉路步行街、黄鹤楼远吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 从民宿到江汉路步行街的距离约1.6公里，步行约20分钟；到黄鹤楼约6公里，打车约20分钟。以上是平时路况下的大致用时，节假日会更久。
knowledge.question_en: How far is it to Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street and the Yellow Crane Tower?
knowledge.answer_en: From the homestay it's about 1.6 km to Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street (about a 20-minute walk) and about 6 km to the Yellow Crane Tower (about 20 minutes by taxi). These are typical times; allow longer on holidays.

knowledge.question_zh: 可以接机或接站吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 本店不提供接机、接站服务。从汉口火车站打车到民宿约20分钟、约25元；从天河机场打车约50分钟、约110元，实际以当天路况和打表为准。
knowledge.question_en: Do you offer airport or train station pickup?
knowledge.answer_en: We don't offer airport or station pickup. A taxi from Hankou Railway Station takes about 20 minutes and costs about 25 yuan; from Tianhe Airport about 50 minutes and about 110 yuan, depending on traffic and the meter on the day.

knowledge.question_zh: 开车来停在哪里？
knowledge.answer_zh: 民宿没有自有停车位，可以停在芸栖路公共停车场，入口在芸栖路20号，走到民宿约3分钟。民宿门口只能临时停车10分钟上下行李，不能过夜停放。
knowledge.question_en: Where can I park if I drive?
knowledge.answer_en: The homestay has no parking of its own. You can use the Yunqi Road public car park (entrance at No. 20 Yunqi Road), about a 3-minute walk away. You may stop at our gate for up to 10 minutes to load or unload, but not park overnight.

knowledge.question_zh: 停车怎么收费？能预留车位吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 芸栖路公共停车场由停车场自行收费：每小时10元，24小时内最高60元，民宿不代收也不报销停车费。民宿无法预留车位，节假日车位紧张，建议优先坐地铁。
knowledge.question_en: How much is parking, and can I reserve a space?
knowledge.answer_en: The Yunqi Road public car park sets its own fees: 10 yuan per hour, capped at 60 yuan per 24 hours. The homestay doesn't collect or reimburse parking fees and can't reserve spaces. Parking is tight on holidays, so the metro is usually easier.

knowledge.question_zh: 提供早餐吗？几点、在哪吃、多少钱？
knowledge.answer_zh: 提供早餐，需要在前一晚21:00前预约。早餐时间为7:30至9:30，在一楼公共客厅用餐，每位28元，身高1.2米以下儿童免费。当天没有预约的无法临时加餐。
knowledge.question_en: Do you serve breakfast? When, where and how much?
knowledge.answer_en: Yes. Breakfast must be booked by 21:00 the night before. It's served 7:30–9:30 in the ground-floor lounge, 28 yuan per person, free for children under 1.2 m. Same-day requests without a booking can't be added.

knowledge.question_zh: 早餐可以做素食或无麸质吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 早餐可以做素食，请在预约时说明。本店早餐不能保证无麸质，也不提供清真餐；有食物过敏请在预约时写明过敏原，厨房无法做到完全避免交叉接触。
knowledge.question_en: Can breakfast be vegetarian or gluten-free?
knowledge.answer_en: Vegetarian breakfast is available; please mention it when booking. We can't guarantee gluten-free food and don't offer halal meals. If you have food allergies, list them when booking; our kitchen can't fully rule out cross-contact.

knowledge.question_zh: 可以带宠物入住吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 本店不接待宠物入住，猫、狗、鸟和爬宠都不能带进房间或公共区域。导盲犬等工作犬除外，请在预订时提前说明。
knowledge.question_en: Can I bring a pet?
knowledge.answer_en: Pets are not allowed, including cats, dogs, birds and reptiles, in rooms or shared areas. Guide dogs and other working dogs are the exception; please let us know when you book.

knowledge.question_zh: 可以加床吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 只有202城景双床房和302家庭套房可以加床，加的是一张1米宽的折叠床，每晚80元，含一套床品，需要至少提前一天申请。其他房间空间不够，不能加床。
knowledge.question_en: Can I get an extra bed?
knowledge.answer_en: Extra beds are only available in Room 202 (City View Twin) and Room 302 (Family Suite): a 1 m folding bed at 80 yuan per night, bedding included, requested at least one day ahead. Other rooms don't have space for an extra bed.

knowledge.question_zh: 有电梯吗？房间在几楼？
knowledge.answer_zh: 楼里没有电梯，一共4层，只能走楼梯。101、102在一楼，201、202在二楼，301、302在三楼，401在四楼。带大件行李或行动不便的客人，建议订一楼的房间。
knowledge.question_en: Is there an elevator? Which floor is each room on?
knowledge.answer_en: There's no elevator; the building has 4 floors with stairs only. Rooms 101 and 102 are on the ground floor, 201 and 202 on the 2nd, 301 and 302 on the 3rd, and 401 on the 4th. With heavy luggage or limited mobility, we suggest a ground-floor room.

knowledge.question_zh: 可以做饭吗？厨房有什么？
knowledge.answer_zh: 一楼有公共厨房，开放时间7:00至22:00，有电磁炉、微波炉、冰箱和基础锅具餐具。楼里没有燃气，也没有燃气灶；为了避免油烟，请不要油炸或爆炒，用完请把餐具洗干净。
knowledge.question_en: Can I cook? What's in the kitchen?
knowledge.answer_en: There's a shared kitchen on the ground floor, open 7:00–22:00, with an induction hob, microwave, fridge and basic cookware and tableware. There's no gas supply or gas stove in the building; please avoid deep-frying or high-heat stir-frying, and wash up after use.

knowledge.question_zh: 有洗衣机吗？在哪里、几点能用？
knowledge.answer_zh: 一楼洗衣房有2台洗衣机和1台烘干机，开放时间8:00至22:00，洗衣机免费使用，洗衣液在洗衣机上方的柜子里。本店不提供代洗和干洗服务。
knowledge.question_en: Is there a washing machine? Where and when can I use it?
knowledge.answer_en: The ground-floor laundry room has 2 washing machines and 1 dryer, open 8:00–22:00. The washing machines are free to use, and detergent is in the cupboard above them. We don't offer a laundry or dry-cleaning service.

knowledge.question_zh: 洗衣和烘干要收费吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 洗衣机每次10元，烘干机每次15元，扫码支付。
knowledge.question_en: Do washing and drying cost money?
knowledge.answer_en: Washing costs 10 yuan per load and drying 15 yuan per load, paid by QR code.

knowledge.question_zh: 可以开发票吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 企业微信直接预订的订单可以开电子增值税普通发票，开票项目为“住宿费”。请在退房后7天内把抬头和税号发给管家，3个工作日内发到您的邮箱。通过携程、美团等平台预订的订单，请在预订平台上申请发票。
knowledge.question_en: Can I get an invoice (fapiao)?
knowledge.answer_en: For bookings made directly through WeCom, we can issue an electronic VAT general invoice for “accommodation”. Send the invoice title and tax ID to the host within 7 days after check-out, and it will be emailed within 3 working days. For bookings via Ctrip, Meituan or other platforms, please request the invoice on that platform.

knowledge.question_zh: 有无障碍房间吗？坐轮椅方便吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 本店没有无障碍客房，入口有2级台阶，没有坡道。101在一楼，卫生间装有扶手，是对行动不便的客人最方便的房间，但卫生间门宽约70厘米，标准轮椅进不去。
knowledge.question_en: Do you have accessible rooms? Is it wheelchair-friendly?
knowledge.answer_en: We don't have accessible rooms. The entrance has 2 steps and no ramp. Room 101 is on the ground floor with grab bars in the bathroom, which makes it the easiest room for guests with limited mobility, but the bathroom door is about 70 cm wide, so a standard wheelchair can't get through.

knowledge.question_zh: 可以抽烟吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 房间、楼道、露台和阳台都禁止吸烟，包括电子烟。需要吸烟请到一楼院子门口的吸烟点，那里有烟灰缸。在室内吸烟需要支付300元深度清洁费。
knowledge.question_en: Can I smoke?
knowledge.answer_en: Smoking, including e-cigarettes, isn't allowed in rooms, hallways, on the terrace or on balconies. Please use the smoking spot at the courtyard gate on the ground floor, where there's an ashtray. Smoking indoors incurs a 300 yuan deep-cleaning fee.

knowledge.question_zh: 可以寄存行李吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 可以免费寄存行李：入住当天10:00起到退房当天20:00前，行李可以放在一楼行李柜。现金、证件和贵重物品请随身携带；退房当天20:00以后不能继续寄存，寄存行李也不代表可以继续使用房间。
knowledge.question_en: Can I store my luggage?
knowledge.answer_en: Yes, free of charge: from 10:00 on check-in day until 20:00 on check-out day, luggage can go in the ground-floor luggage lockers. Please keep cash, ID and valuables with you. Storage isn't available after 20:00 on check-out day, and storing luggage doesn't extend your use of the room.

knowledge.question_zh: Wi-Fi叫什么？密码是多少？
knowledge.answer_zh: 每个房间有独立Wi-Fi，名称是“Yunqi-房号”（例如Yunqi-201），密码是yunqi2026；公共区域的Wi-Fi是Yunqi-Lobby，密码相同。
knowledge.question_en: What's the Wi-Fi name and password?
knowledge.answer_en: Each room has its own Wi-Fi named “Yunqi-<room number>” (e.g. Yunqi-201) with the password yunqi2026. The shared-area network is Yunqi-Lobby with the same password.

knowledge.question_zh: 网速怎么样？能开视频会议吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 全楼是300M光纤宽带，每个房间一台独立路由器，视频会议和看高清视频一般没问题；四楼401信号稍弱，可以用房间里的有线网口。
knowledge.question_en: How fast is the internet? Is it good enough for video calls?
knowledge.answer_en: The building has 300 Mbps fibre broadband with a separate router in each room, which is usually fine for video calls and HD streaming. The signal in Room 401 on the 4th floor is a little weaker, so you can use the room's Ethernet port.

knowledge.question_zh: 带孩子入住有什么要注意的？
knowledge.answer_zh: 12岁以下儿童和大人同住、不占床的，不加收费用。婴儿床可以免费借用，全店只有1张，请提前申请。楼梯没有儿童护栏，请看护好孩子。
knowledge.question_en: Anything to know about staying with children?
knowledge.answer_en: Children under 12 sharing existing beds with adults stay at no extra charge. We can lend one baby cot for free (only one available, so please request it in advance). The stairs have no child gates, so please keep an eye on little ones.

knowledge.question_zh: 连住期间多久打扫一次？
knowledge.answer_zh: 连住期间每3晚免费打扫一次，打扫时间在10:00至16:00之间，请提前一天在企业微信预约；需要额外打扫每次50元。住宿期间垃圾可以放在房门外，每天10:00统一收走。
knowledge.question_en: How often is the room cleaned during a longer stay?
knowledge.answer_en: For multi-night stays we clean the room for free once every 3 nights, between 10:00 and 16:00; please book a day ahead on WeCom. Extra cleaning is 50 yuan each time. You can leave rubbish outside your door; it's collected daily at 10:00.

knowledge.question_zh: 多久换一次床单？有备用被子和枕头吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 每位客人入住前都会更换全套床品；连住期间每3晚免费更换一次床单被套，其他时间需要换洗每次30元。衣柜上层有备用被子和枕头，想要荞麦枕可以找管家借。
knowledge.question_en: How often are sheets changed? Are there spare duvets and pillows?
knowledge.answer_en: All bedding is changed before each new guest. During multi-night stays, sheets and duvet covers are changed for free once every 3 nights; other changes are 30 yuan each. Spare duvets and pillows are on the top shelf of the wardrobe, and you can ask the host to borrow a buckwheat pillow.

knowledge.question_zh: 提供毛巾和洗漱用品吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 每个房间提供浴巾、毛巾、洗发水、护发素和沐浴露。为了减少一次性用品，房间里不放牙刷牙膏，需要的话可以到一楼公共客厅的自助架免费领取。
knowledge.question_en: Do you provide towels and toiletries?
knowledge.answer_en: Each room has bath towels, hand towels, shampoo, conditioner and body wash. To reduce single-use items, toothbrushes and toothpaste aren't placed in rooms, but you can pick them up for free from the self-service shelf in the ground-floor lounge.

knowledge.question_zh: 空调怎么调？冬天有暖气吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 每个房间都有独立的冷暖空调，遥控器在床头柜抽屉里，温度可以调到16至30℃。楼里没有暖气和地暖，12月到次年2月每张床会加一条电热毯。
knowledge.question_en: How do I use the air conditioning? Is there heating in winter?
knowledge.answer_en: Each room has its own heating and cooling air conditioner; the remote is in the bedside drawer and it adjusts from 16 to 30°C. There's no central or floor heating; from December to February each bed also gets an electric blanket.

knowledge.question_zh: 热水是24小时的吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 每个房间都有独立卫生间和60升电热水器，热水24小时供应。两个人连着洗澡后，建议等约20分钟再洗，让水重新加热。
knowledge.question_en: Is hot water available 24 hours?
knowledge.answer_en: Every room has a private bathroom with a 60-litre electric water heater, and hot water is available 24 hours. After two people shower back to back, please wait about 20 minutes for it to reheat.

knowledge.question_zh: 房间有浴缸吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 只有301浴缸大床房有浴缸，其他房间都是淋浴。
knowledge.question_en: Does the room have a bathtub?
knowledge.answer_en: Only Room 301 (Bathtub King) has a bathtub; all other rooms have a shower.

knowledge.question_zh: 晚上几点以后要保持安静？
knowledge.answer_zh: 每天22:00至次日8:00是安静时段，请调低说话和设备的音量。公共客厅22:00关闭，本店不接待聚会和派对。
knowledge.question_en: What are the quiet hours?
knowledge.answer_en: Quiet hours are 22:00 to 8:00 every day; please keep voices and devices down. The shared lounge closes at 22:00, and parties or gatherings aren't allowed.

knowledge.question_zh: 朋友可以来房间坐坐吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 访客可以在22:00前来访，来之前请告诉管家访客人数；访客不能留宿，超过订单人数留宿需要另外预订。
knowledge.question_en: Can friends visit my room?
knowledge.answer_en: Visitors are welcome until 22:00; please let the host know how many are coming. Visitors can't stay overnight; extra overnight guests need a separate booking.

knowledge.question_zh: 插座是什么规格？能用大功率电器吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 房间插座是220V国标两孔和三孔，床头有USB充电口。请不要使用1500W以上的大功率电器，例如电煮锅、电暖器。如果跳闸，电闸在入户门后上方的白色配电箱里，可以把跳下的开关推回一次；再次跳闸请停止使用该电器并联系管家。
knowledge.question_en: What are the sockets like? Can I use high-power appliances?
knowledge.answer_en: Sockets are 220V Chinese-standard two- and three-pin, with USB charging ports by the bed. Please don't use appliances over 1500W, such as electric hot pots or heaters. If the power trips, the breaker box is the white panel above the inside of the entrance door; you can push the tripped switch back up once, and if it trips again, stop using that appliance and contact the host.

knowledge.question_zh: 自来水能直接喝吗？有饮用水吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 自来水不建议直接饮用。每个房间每天免费提供2瓶矿泉水，房间里有电热水壶，一楼公共客厅有24小时直饮水机。
knowledge.question_en: Can I drink the tap water? Is drinking water provided?
knowledge.answer_en: We don't recommend drinking tap water directly. Each room gets 2 free bottles of mineral water per day, there's an electric kettle in the room, and the ground-floor lounge has a 24-hour drinking water dispenser.

knowledge.question_zh: 可以代收快递吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 可以代收入住前3天内寄到的快递，收件人请写“芸栖小楼+房号+姓名”，包裹会放在一楼行李柜。生鲜、贵重物品和到付件不代收，丢失或损坏无法负责。
knowledge.question_en: Can you receive parcels for me?
knowledge.answer_en: We can receive parcels that arrive within 3 days before your check-in. Address them to “芸栖小楼 + room number + your name”; they'll be placed in the ground-floor luggage lockers. We don't accept fresh food, valuables or cash-on-delivery parcels, and can't be responsible for loss or damage.

knowledge.question_zh: 房间有电视或投影吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 每个房间都有可以投屏的智能电视，视频会员需要用您自己的账号登录。302家庭套房和401顶层阁楼另外配有投影仪。
knowledge.question_en: Is there a TV or projector?
knowledge.answer_en: Every room has a smart TV that supports screen casting; streaming memberships need your own account. Room 302 (Family Suite) and Room 401 (Top-floor Loft) also have a projector.

knowledge.question_zh: 灭火器和安全出口在哪里？
knowledge.answer_zh: 每层楼梯口都有灭火器，每个房间都装有烟雾报警器。安全出口是一楼正门和通往院子的后门，房门背面贴有逃生路线图。
knowledge.question_en: Where are the fire extinguishers and emergency exits?
knowledge.answer_en: There's a fire extinguisher at the stairwell on every floor, and every room has a smoke alarm. The exits are the main door and the back door to the courtyard on the ground floor; an evacuation map is on the back of each room door.

knowledge.question_zh: 有公共客厅或露台吗？几点开放？
knowledge.answer_zh: 一楼公共客厅8:00至22:00开放，有沙发、书架和桌游。顶楼露台9:00至21:00开放，下雨天关闭，露台禁止吸烟和明火。
knowledge.question_en: Is there a shared lounge or terrace? When are they open?
knowledge.answer_en: The ground-floor lounge is open 8:00–22:00 with sofas, books and board games. The rooftop terrace is open 9:00–21:00 and closed when it rains; no smoking or open flames on the terrace.

knowledge.question_zh: 可以借吹风机、熨斗、雨伞这些东西吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 每个房间都有吹风机。一楼公共客厅可以免费借挂烫机、雨伞、转换插头和桌游；充电宝需要交100元押金，归还时退回。
knowledge.question_en: Can I borrow a hair dryer, iron or umbrella?
knowledge.answer_en: Every room has a hair dryer. In the ground-floor lounge you can borrow a garment steamer, umbrellas, plug adapters and board games for free; power banks need a 100 yuan deposit, which you get back when you return them.

knowledge.question_zh: 入住要交押金吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 入住不收押金。房间物品如有损坏，按物品标价赔偿。
knowledge.question_en: Is there a deposit?
knowledge.answer_en: No deposit is required. If anything in the room is damaged, it's charged at the listed price.

knowledge.question_zh: 每间房是什么床、能住几个人？
knowledge.answer_zh: 101庭院大床房、201城景大床房和301浴缸大床房是1.8米大床，住2人；102庭院双床房和202城景双床房是两张1.2米单人床，住2人；302家庭套房有两间卧室，1.8米和1.5米床各一张，住4人；401顶层阁楼是阁楼夹层上的1.5米床，住2人。
knowledge.question_en: What beds does each room have, and how many people can stay?
knowledge.answer_en: Rooms 101 (Courtyard King), 201 (City View King) and 301 (Bathtub King) have a 1.8 m bed for 2 guests; 102 (Courtyard Twin) and 202 (City View Twin) have two 1.2 m single beds for 2 guests; 302 (Family Suite) has two bedrooms with a 1.8 m and a 1.5 m bed for 4 guests; 401 (Top-floor Loft) has a 1.5 m bed on the mezzanine for 2 guests.

knowledge.question_zh: 东西落在房间里怎么办？
knowledge.answer_zh: 退房后发现的遗留物品会保管30天。请告诉管家入住日期、房号和物品描述，找到后可以到店自取，或用快递到付寄回。
knowledge.question_en: I left something in the room. What should I do?
knowledge.answer_en: Items found after check-out are kept for 30 days. Tell the host your stay dates, room number and a description of the item; once found, you can collect it in person or have it sent by courier with postage paid on delivery.

knowledge.question_zh: 订单可以取消或改期吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 通过平台预订的订单按平台规则办理。企业微信直接预订的订单：入住日前3天（含）以前可以免费取消或改期一次；之后取消收取首晚房费。具体能否办理和金额由管家核对订单后回复。
knowledge.question_en: Can I cancel or change my booking?
knowledge.answer_en: Bookings made on a platform follow that platform's rules. For bookings made directly via WeCom, you can cancel for free or change dates once up to 3 days before check-in (inclusive); after that, cancellation costs the first night. The host will check your booking and reply with what's possible and the exact amount.

knowledge.question_zh: 401顶层阁楼有什么需要注意的？
knowledge.answer_zh: 401顶层阁楼的床在夹层上，需要爬木梯上下，不建议6岁以下儿童和行动不便的客人入住。夏天夹层偏热，空调装在楼下，建议睡前30分钟先开空调。
knowledge.question_en: Anything to know about Room 401 (Top-floor Loft)?
knowledge.answer_en: In Room 401 the bed is on a mezzanine reached by a wooden ladder, so it isn't recommended for children under 6 or guests with limited mobility. The mezzanine gets warm in summer and the air conditioner is on the lower level, so switch it on about 30 minutes before bed.

knowledge.question_zh: 国庆期间早餐时间有变化吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 2026年10月1日至7日国庆期间，早餐时间调整为8:00至10:00，地点和价格不变。
knowledge.question_en: Are breakfast hours different during the National Day holiday?
knowledge.answer_en: During the National Day holiday (1–7 October 2026), breakfast is served 8:00–10:00; the location and price stay the same.

knowledge.question_zh: 附近有便利店和早餐店吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 民宿附近的芸栖路上有一家24小时便利店，步行约2分钟；巷口的“芸记热干面”早上6:30开门。这些都是周边商户，与本店无关，营业时间以商户当天为准。
knowledge.question_en: Is there a convenience store or breakfast place nearby?
knowledge.answer_en: There's a 24-hour convenience store on Yunqi Road near the homestay, about a 2-minute walk, and “Yunji Hot Dry Noodles” at the lane entrance opens at 6:30. These are independent local businesses, not part of the homestay; opening hours may vary.

knowledge.question_zh: 闻到燃气味怎么办？
knowledge.answer_zh: 楼里没有燃气管道和燃气灶。如果闻到类似燃气或焦糊的气味，请立即开窗通风，离开房间到一楼院子等候，不要开关电器、不要使用明火。气味可能来自邻楼，管家会马上联系物业确认。
knowledge.question_en: What should I do if I smell gas?
knowledge.answer_en: There is no gas supply in the building. If you smell gas or burning, open the windows, leave the room and wait in the ground-floor courtyard. Do not switch any electrical device on or off and do not use an open flame.

knowledge.question_zh: 着火或冒烟怎么办？
knowledge.answer_zh: 请立即离开房间，走楼梯下到一楼，从正门或通往院子的后门离开。每层楼梯口都有灭火器，火很小且确认安全时可以使用；有明火或浓烟请立即拨打119。
knowledge.question_en: What should I do if there is fire or smoke?
knowledge.answer_en: Leave the room at once, take the stairs to the ground floor and exit through the front door or the back door to the courtyard. Every stairway has a fire extinguisher. If there is an open fire or thick smoke, call 119 immediately.

knowledge.question_zh: 漏电或有人触电怎么办？
knowledge.answer_zh: 请不要触碰漏电部位和潮湿处的电器。配电箱在入户门后上方的白色箱子里，能安全操作时把总闸拉下；有人触电请立即拨打120，不要直接用手拉触电的人。
knowledge.question_en: What should I do about an electric leak or shock?
knowledge.answer_en: Do not touch the leaking or wet parts. The white power box is above the inside of the entrance door; switch off the main breaker only if you can do so safely. If anyone has been shocked, call 120 and do not pull them with bare hands.

knowledge.question_zh: 有人突然不舒服或受伤怎么办？
knowledge.answer_zh: 如有生命危险请立即拨打120。急救到达前不要随意搬动伤者，一楼公共客厅有急救箱。
knowledge.question_en: What should I do if someone is suddenly ill or injured?
knowledge.answer_en: If there is any risk to life, call 120 immediately. Do not move the injured person before help arrives. There is a first-aid kit in the ground-floor lounge.

knowledge.question_zh: 有人威胁或骚扰怎么办？
knowledge.answer_zh: 如人身安全受到威胁，请立即拨打110报警，回到房间锁好门，或到一楼公共客厅等有人的地方等候。
knowledge.question_en: What should I do if someone threatens me?
knowledge.answer_en: If your safety is threatened, call 110 at once, lock yourself in your room or wait in the ground-floor lounge where other people are.

knowledge.question_zh: 进不了房间怎么办？
knowledge.answer_zh: 如果进不了门，请先到一楼公共客厅等候，那里有座位和饮用水，管家会远程核对门锁。
knowledge.question_en: What should I do if I cannot get into my room?
knowledge.answer_en: If you cannot get in, please wait in the ground-floor lounge, where there are seats and drinking water. The host will check the lock remotely.
